text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hm-hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm finally here, the Takarazuka Kinen! 
Hmm...”

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro Ramonu? I know she's strong, 
but... I'm a Derby devotee, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Won't it be a bit tough going up against 
girls who've been through the Classic 
Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! It's definitely Mejiro Ramonu! 
She's seriously strong, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, this feeling! It's great, it 
feels like a real race!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“That's surprising, though. To think there 
are people who look at Ramonu with doubt.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Now then, what will you do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Chuckle... Fufu...

"Before the race... Mejiro Ramonu seemed 
somewhat off."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
An atmosphere different from anything 
before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I am being tested. To see whether this 
love is the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The opponent, the gazes... everything is 
completely different from before."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaah... My heart is racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see. Do you want to put that on top 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well. Isn't this fun—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Lady Mejiro Ramonuuu~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah~~!!

When Mejiro Ramonu appeared in the 
paddock, thunderous cheers echoed all 
around. Shrill cheers erupted at her every 
move. However...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
Fan C
text_block_list.text: Wah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's quite alright. Glare at me even 
more...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Doubt it. And brush it off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Feel free to use it as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because once today is over, I won't be 
able to do "that" anymore.
